name: progress
description: Explicit issue progress and reported activity, with a native pane and a shared Overview snapshot.

owner_workflow.title: Owner merge workflow
owner_workflow.description: Show the user-only merge when green action. Off for clean colleague installs; requires an explicit confirmation and branch protections. Never called by agent tools.

web_controls.title: Web refresh
web_controls.description: Allow explicit Overview web refresh requests to read GitHub metadata and publish this session snapshot without a model. Starts only after explicit Progress use; remains available while the pane is hidden.

web_owner_workflow.title: Web owner workflow
web_owner_workflow.description: Allow the authenticated Overview web view to prepare, confirm or cancel owner merge actions. Requires owner_workflow and web_controls. Separate opt-in from metadata refresh.
